component.name: KeeperFX Map Editor
component.summary: Map editor for KeeperFX, the Dungeon Keeper 1 engine

description.p: Edit KeeperFX levels in one program: terrain with the game's slab placement rules, creatures, objects, traps, doors, effect generators, action points and lights, the DK level script, Lua scripts, and play-testing in the game.
The editor ships no game assets. It needs a KeeperFX installation and reads art and configuration from it.
